Place the phone side-on to the court, ideally on a tripod. Leave room above so the ball toss fits in frame. Tap record on screen or from the watch.
Set your dominant hand in Settings (⚙️ top right). With a Galaxy Watch you can start recording and see your score and tip right on your wrist.
